status: Offline methodology and explicit-configuration net-YPP prototype; calibration/source coverage under research; no new public ranking
question: How efficiently did each team play in the completed games we can actually measure?

threeViews.strengthOfRecord: What record did the team earn against its schedule? Keep the approved division-aware SOR calculation unchanged.
threeViews.performance: How well did the team execute on the field after opponent and context adjustment? Current-season observed performance, with its own coverage record.
threeViews.predictiveStrength: What does the model expect in the next matchup? Keep the existing margin/history model separate until a separately tested forecast replacement is justified.

prohibitedInputs: Human polls or manually ranked teams
Betting lines, spreads or Vegas win probabilities
Manual corrections selected to produce familiar ranks
A hidden blend with SOR or predictive strength

requiredInventory: Endpoint or immutable bulk-file identity and usage terms
Free-tier access verified without assuming every endpoint is included
Data dictionary and actual sample fields
Game-level FBS coverage, FCS/opponent context coverage, and missingness by year
Whether special teams, overtime and situational fields are available
Existing EPA model artifact, features and training dates if supplied
dataGate.publicationDenominator: All completed eligible games in the corresponding SOR snapshot, plus a separate denominator for all FBS teams. Missing measured games must not silently disappear from either denominator.
dataGate.noFabrication: Missing statistics are unavailable, not zero. Unknown subdivision is not FCS. A mismatched identity, partial game or unsupported field cannot be filled by team name, reputation or an invented national-average game.
dataGate.timing: Use actual retained retrieval times. Old corrected bulk files support retrospective analysis, not proof that advanced statistics were available at a historical cutoff.

preferredIfVerified.name: Opponent-adjusted scrimmage EPA per play
preferredIfVerified.reason: Measures changes in field-position/down/distance scoring value in point units. Offense and defense remain inspectable components.
requirements: Audited eligible scrimmage play types and possession direction
Known EP/EPA artifact version and scoring transformations
No poll/recruiting/betting feature directly or through an auxiliary model
preferredIfVerified.restriction: A supplied EPA column is a model output, not automatically our own objective ground truth. Distinct EPA generations cannot be mixed into one unversioned series.

fallbackIfOnlyBoxesAreVerified.name: Opponent-adjusted yards per scrimmage play
fallbackIfOnlyBoxesAreVerified.publicLabelIfExposed: Scrimmage efficiency prototype; incomplete performance coverage
fallbackIfOnlyBoxesAreVerified.formula: Offensive yards divided by offensive scrimmage plays; defense is the corresponding yards per play allowed, with the same source definitions on both sides.
requirements: Verified total offensive yards and scrimmage-play denominator, or an exactly reconcilable reconstruction
Both teams' game statistics and explicit missing-field detection
NCAA/provider sack accounting and overtime inclusion documented
limits: Yards do not price down/distance, short fields, turnovers or scoring opportunities correctly
No play-level garbage-time, kneel or overtime correction is possible when the source only supplies full-game totals
A yards/play-only result must not be called a complete overall-performance ranking

diagnosticsNotAutomaticExtraWeights: Success rate under one explicitly versioned definition
Sacks and pressure when their denominator is known

adjustmentModel.unitStructure: The initial executable prototype fits one-dimensional paired net YPP, not separate offense/defense ratings. A later candidate may fit offensive production against defensive allowance jointly.
adjustmentModel.proposedObservationEquation: Future unit-decomposition candidate only: game offensive rate = season baseline + team offensive effect - opponent defensive effect + learned venue/context terms + residual
adjustmentModel.signConvention: Higher offensive effect and higher defensive effect are better. A defensive observation describes production allowed, so the opponent defensive effect enters with a minus sign.
adjustmentModel.regularization: Shrink sparse current-season unit effects toward a neutral reference using an explicitly chosen regularization method. No previous team season supplies unearned current-season performance credit. Select shrinkage only through the declared older-season training procedure.
adjustmentModel.paceAndWeights: Rates remove the direct reward for accumulating more plays. Play counts still control precision and can create leverage. Compare declared play-weighted and game-weighted fits; estimate uncertainty with game/team dependence acknowledged. Do not imply per-play rates remove every pace or game-state effect.
adjustmentModel.overallScore: Show offense and defense separately first. If a single scrimmage score is justified, use effects in the same declared units and show its derivation. Do not invent a percentage blend of EPA, success rate, yards, sacks and turnovers.
adjustmentModel.subdivision: Use season-specific membership, retain opponents individually, and test residual FBS/FCS bias within this metric. The SOR division coefficient is in win log-odds and cannot be reused in yards/play or EPA/play. Unknown or sparse opponent context requires explicit coverage/sensitivity reporting rather than an automatic penalty.
adjustmentModel.venue: Estimate venue effects from older matched performance observations. The SOR home log-odds and predictive home points are not interchangeable with this model's units.
adjustmentModel.conference: No conference prestige parameter or manual group multiplier. Cross-conference/subdivision connectivity and uncertainty must be reported.
adjustmentModel.reference: Use a declared same-season reference population and report how inactive or sparsely observed teams enter it. Do not rank a team solely from its shrinkage baseline.

accountingRules.sacks: Reconcile the source's college-football totals before reconstructing plays or yards. Never subtract sack yardage again when the source rushing/total-yard figure already includes it.
accountingRules.turnovers: A turnover's observed EPA belongs in an observed-performance EPA measure. Do not add a second turnover bonus. A separate luck-adjusted predictive variant must be named and validated separately; do not retroactively erase a real play from earned performance.
accountingRules.specialTeams: Initially show coverage and raw diagnostics separately. A total team-performance composite needs defensible common-unit attribution for field goals, punts, kickoffs and returns, without counting a return/defensive score twice. Missing special teams are not average special teams.
accountingRules.overtime: Regulation-only and full-game views require explicit play/period data. Do not infer regulation box totals from the final score. Freeze an overtime policy and compare its effect before model promotion.
accountingRules.gameState: Use an all-eligible-plays baseline, with separately declared kneel/spike/no-play rules. Any garbage-time sensitivity must use only pre-play observable state or an audited frozen model; never the eventual winning margin or a Vegas-derived win-probability filter.
accountingRules.uncertainty: Plays within drives/games and teams across weeks are dependent. Naive independent-play standard errors or a percentile rank are not calibrated confidence intervals.

validation.beforeFit: Write and checksum a concrete experiment protocol after the source/field inventory. Freeze candidate definitions, training windows, excluded years, tuning method and diagnostics before examining the new ranking order.
validation.trainingSelection: The concrete net-YPP experiment uses the older years and fixed ridge grid in initialExecutablePrototype.settingsSelectionProposal. Other metric families remain future candidates and require their own written selection protocol.
validation.alreadyInspected: The current project has inspected historical game-result seasons and 2026 ranking illustrations. New advanced fields do not magically make the familiar seasons untouched prospective evidence. A downstream split also fails if the upstream EPA model trained on its future evaluation data.
metrics: Coverage and missingness by team, season, opponent subdivision and field
Future game efficiency prediction error against an unadjusted-rate benchmark
Subgroup bias and calibration where a probability model is actually used
Consequential game-level disagreements explained from measured statistics
validation.interpretation: Future efficiency prediction is a useful reliability check, not proof of a uniquely correct performance or achievement order. Poll agreement, pleasing Top25 membership and low volatility cannot select the winner.
correctnessChecks: Team/conference renaming and input order leave numbers unchanged
A game appears once per team with matched opponent orientation
Raw counts reconstruct published rates within declared rounding tolerances
Sacks and turnovers are not double counted
No future result, advanced statistic or model-trained-on-future feature enters a claimed historical forecast
Missing or zero-opportunity denominators produce an unavailable metric
Venue and subdivision terms have correct units and reverse orientation correctly
Idle teams stay unranked and sparse teams are marked provisional
Existing SOR and predictive-strength outputs remain numerically unchanged
validation.promotion: Publish source coverage, a reproducible report and limitations; freeze the performance candidate before genuine future observation. A complete third ranking requires adequate all-FBS measurement and explicit component scope, not just a third button.

operations.budget: Zero dollars. The user reports a 1000-call monthly CFBD allowance; current weekly operation uses two successful calls per run. Verify endpoint eligibility and planned call count before changing it.
operations.preferredPath: Reuse cached/bulk free raw statistics or one bulk season endpoint when the verified free tier supports it. Avoid one request per team or game when bulk fields suffice.
operations.refresh: Attach any eventual approved component to the existing Sunday 08:00 America/Denver publication. Visitors read stored snapshots and do not trigger provider calls.
operations.storage: Retain normalized measured-game records, raw-source hashes, coverage counts, definitions and model version in a separate namespace. Preserve the existing SOR and forecast observation histories.
operations.currentStage: Methodology plus a pure explicit-configuration offline fitter. These files make no CFBD calls, add no schedule, change no public ranking and require no paid service.

initialExecutablePrototype.question: Opponent-adjusted net yards per scrimmage play in measured current-season games
initialExecutablePrototype.observation: One matched game, target teamA yards/plays minus teamB yards/plays; one game weight, not one weight per team row
initialExecutablePrototype.equation: netYpp_game = ratingA - ratingB + homeYpp * orientedVenue + residual
initialExecutablePrototype.objective: Sum of squared game residuals plus ridge times sum of squared team effects
initialExecutablePrototype.configuration: Explicit ridge and homeYpp; no learned or engineering defaults, no history, wins, final margins, polls or conference effects

settingsSelectionProposal.homeFit: For each fixed ridge, use the exact affine homeYpp response on cutoff-safe prior-week networks to fit older FBS-FBS net-YPP residuals; then select ridge on chronological validation MSE
settingsSelectionProposal.limits: Previously inspected seasons and corrected box-score data; later results do not constitute genuinely prospective evidence

initialExecutablePrototype.unitDiagnostics: Raw offensive YPP and defensive YPP allowed are shown separately but are not adjusted offense/defense unit ratings
initialExecutablePrototype.coverage: All measured opponents retain individual identity. Idle teams unranked, fewer than four games marked provisional without dropping observed games; minimum play counts and opponent measured-game counts reported
initialExecutablePrototype.scope: Scrimmage-efficiency research proxy only; no special-teams/turnover/situational composite or automatic promotion
